title: Engineering Refreshed
description: Create mod based modpack designed for survival alone or with friends!
body:
# 🛠️ Engineering Refreshed

Welcome to **Engineering Refreshed**, a carefully curated Vanilla+ modpack that completely reimagines Minecraft automation, engineering, and aviation without sacrificing the core charm of the base game. 

Whether you want to build massive fully-automated factories, take to the skies in custom-built airships, or explore a beautifully enhanced world, Engineering Refreshed delivers a smooth, highly optimized experience from the ground up.

---

## ⚙️ Core Mechanics

*   **Aviation & Airships:** Thanks to **Create Aeronautics** and **Create: Aeroworks**, the sky is no longer the limit. Build actual flying contraptions, physics-based airships, and custom aircraft. 
*   **Massive Addon Ecosystem:** Dive deep into specific branches of engineering with **Create Diesel Generators**, **Create Big Cannons**, **Create Nuclear**, and **The Factory Must Grow**.
*   **Logistics & Trains:** Optimize your rail networks with **Create: Threaded Trains**, **Railways Navigator**, and **Contraption Terminals**.
*   **Quality of Life Automation:** Features like **Create Slice & Dice**, **Enchantment Industry**, and **Mechanical Extruder** keep your factories running smoothly.

---

## 🚀 Hyper-Optimized

*   **Graphics & Rendering:** Powered by **Sodium**, **Iris**, **ImmediatelyFast**, and **EntityCulling**.
*   **Memory & Logic:** Features **Lithium**, **Ferrite Core**, **ModernFix**, **Saturn**, and **BadOptimizations** to drastically reduce RAM usage and stuttering.
*   **Create-Specific Fixes:** Includes **Iris Flywheel Compat** and **CreateBetterFps** so your massive rotating contraptions won't tank your frame rate.

---

## 🌍 Vanilla+

*   **Biomes & Structures:** Explore stunning landscapes with **Biomes O' Plenty** and **Structory**, and uncover secrets in the **Stoneholm Underground Villages**.
*   **Life & Fauna:** Encounter realistic and fantastical creatures with **Alex's Mobs** and **Critters and Companions**.
*   **Culinary Arts:** Become a master chef with **Farmer's Delight** and **Ocean's Delight**.
*   **Building & Decoration:** Build the ultimate workshop using the complete suite of **Macaw's** building mods, **Design n' Decor**, **Create Deco**, and **Supplementaries**.

---

## 🧰 QoL & Storage

*   **Storage Solved:** Keep your inventory organized with **Sophisticated Backpacks** (fully integrated with Create) and **Tom's Simple Storage Mod** for physical, accessible item networks.
*   **Navigation:** Never get lost again with **Xaero's Minimap** and **Xaero's World Map**.
*   **Information at a Glance:** Full recipe and UI clarity with **EMI (and Extra Mod Integrations)**, **Jade**, and **AppleSkin**.
*   **Multiplayer Ready:** Includes **Essential Mod** and **e4mc** so you can host worlds and play with your friends flawlessly without needing a dedicated server.

---

## 📦 Key Mods

*   **Technology:** Create, Create Aeronautics, CBC Advanced Technology, Create: New Age, Create Power Grid.
*   **Optimization:** Sodium, Lithium, Ferrite Core, ModernFix, CCME, Alternate Current.
*   **World & Magic:** Biomes O' Plenty, Waystones, Gravestone Mod, Carry On.
*   **UI & Utilities:** EMI, Jade, Clumps, Controlling, Mouse Tweaks, ShulkerBoxTooltip.
